question: How was Wilt Chamberlain shooting his free throws on the night he scored 100 points in 1962?
answer: Underhand, and he made 28 of 32. That season, tossing the ball up from between his knees, he hit about 61% of his free throws. He later went back to shooting overhand and finished his career near 51%. Rick Barry, who never gave up the underhand style, made about 90%.
move: A method that works can still lose to one that looks better.
reference: Pomerantz, Wilt, 1962: The Night of 100 Points and the Dawn of a New Era, Crown, 2005
